title: ai-rulez verify --attestation
description: Output of `ai-rulez verify --attestation --format json`: the outcome of verifying the signed lock, or with --bundle, --skill or --sbom a plugin bundle, a published skill or an SBOM file (docs/signing.md).

key_id.description: sha256:<hex> fingerprint of the signing key (key mode).

code.description: The AR code of the failure; absent when valid.

attestation.description: The bundle file that was read.

signed_at.description: When the transparency log or timestamp authority saw the signature; absent for a log-less key signature.

logged.description: The bundle carries a transparency log entry.

weak.description: No log or timestamp: freshness rests on the signer's own claim.

age_seconds.description: Seconds since the signature was made.

digest.description: The digest of the verified bundle, skill directory or file (not set for the lock).

signers.description: Every distinct trusted signer, when more than one signed ([signing] thresholds).

provenance.description: The verified SLSA provenance next to a bundle.

builder.description: The builder id the provenance names.
